title: Finance & Legal - personal todo scratchpad
body: Personal scratchpad for daily finance/legal tasks - quick notes, reminders, and actions.
2026-03-04 morning check: inbox triage for AP + contract items.
TODAY priority: 1) Approve vendor invoice for CloudInfra (INV-2026-0179) - $42,350. Need: PO #, verify delivery dates. Contact: Alex Kim. Deadline for payment run: 2026-03-05.

TODAY priority: 2) Finish redlines for Partner MSA w/ DataSync. Sections to revisit: 5 (IP), 9 (liability cap), 12 (data processing). Draft comments saved in Google Doc; ask Legal for language re: subprocessing (Lena to review by EOD).

Invoice follow-ups: - Stripe Connected fee reconciliation (Feb) - reconcile statement vs QuickBooks entries (Diego assigned). - Contractor invoices: Priya Menon (SOW-2026-02) missing timesheet; ping Slack.

Renewals: - Box subscription (team backup) auto-renews 2026-04-02: decide whether to consolidate licenses. - Model hosting contract (Vendor: FastServe) renewal notice received 2026-03-10 (60d prior). Set reminder to review usage and negotiate discount. Add to renewal tracker (Confluence).

Open contract items: - Redline summary for Acme Corp (sales-led) - highlight termination notice period change requested by Sales. Need to confirm acceptable notice length with Product. - NDAs: onboarding NDAs template needs update (add clause for telemetry logs).
Payments ops notes: - Weekly payment runs on Fridays; next run 2026-03-06. Add INV-2026-0179 to Friday queue if PO confirmed. - Bank cutoff for ACH: 15:00 PT; schedule approvals accordingly.

Questions to resolve: - Can we accept Net-60 for this vendor? Finance policy says default Net-30; exceptions require FP&A signoff (Finance Lead). - Is there a prepaid credit for FastServe from 2025 that can offset renewal? Check accounting credits spreadsheet.

Quick actions (short): - Slack Alex re: CloudInfra PO - Upload signed SOW for contractor to Drive - Add FastServe renewal to 1:1 agenda with Head of Procurement - Ask Legal (Lena) about alternate liability cap language for enterprise deals
Notes-to-self: keep date-stamped notes in this doc when I call/pay vendors so I can paste into Confluence later. Use the template 'Vendor payment log - YYYY-MM' for bookkeeping.
Links / refs: invoice PDF naming convention: vendor-INV-YYYY-NNN.pdf; contract redlines stored in Drive under shared_drives/company/contracts/drafts/; renewal tracker: Confluence page id above.

End-of-day 2026-03-03 quick log: - Sent reminder to Priya for timesheet. - Uploaded CloudInfra invoice to AP folder but waiting on PO. - Prepared initial redline for Partner MSA and flagged IP clause for Legal review.

Tomorrow plan (2026-03-05): morning - chase PO + confirm payment run; noon - sync with Lena on MSA redlines; afternoon - review FastServe usage metrics and prepare negotiation points for renewal call next week.
Misc/brainstorm: consider proposing a standardized contract playbook (4 templates: NDA, MSA-SaaS, SOW, vendor procurement) to reduce review cycle time. Pitch to Legal Ops next week.
